name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: An AI skill that draws clean, professional-looking diagrams for docs and pitch decks, instead of the generic boxes-and-arrows look most AI tools produce.
buyer: A startup founder or technical content marketer who needs good-looking explainer diagrams but can't afford a designer.
business_use_cases: A startup founder generates investor-deck diagrams (architecture, funnel, roadmap) without hiring a designer.
A technical content agency offers 'AI-diagrammed blog posts' as an add-on service, producing explainer graphics for client articles.
A freelance consultant sells a same-day 'diagram pack' gig: the client describes a process and gets 10 polished diagrams back.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a same-day diagram-pack gig on a freelance marketplace.
Offer it as a monthly add-on inside a content or design agency's retainer.

steal_this: List a '5 polished pitch-deck diagrams in 24 hours' gig for $99 this weekend using this skill.
